title: Interpret Tote Tasks (Aveva API) current task exchange type, priority, destination, and readiness
summary: Use the Tote Tasks Aveva API interface to read the current tote task’s exchange type, priority, original destination, station, and whether it is ready for exchange. When shown, also capture whether an AUV behind it is ready to go (and which stations it is at) and whether it is associated with the sorter task UID, plus the task name and tote ID.
when_to_use: When diagnosing tote movement/exchange behavior and you need to report what the current tote task is doing (exchange type/priority/destination/station) and whether it is ready for exchange, including any AUV-behind readiness and sorter task UID linkage shown on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Access and read the Tote Tasks Aveva API page fields (exchange type, priority, original destination, station, ready-for-exchange, AUV-behind readiness/stations, sorter task UID, task name, tote ID) and report them for diagnosis.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen
Ability to view/tap the “Task Name” field/control on that page

access_required: Access to the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen

visual_references.description: Tote Tasks Aveva API page frame showing the current task/exchange fields (exchange type, priority, original destination, ready for exchange, AUV-behind readiness/stations, sorter task UID, task name, tote ID).

steps.title: Open the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen shown in the training frame
steps.purpose: Get to the Tote Tasks interface where the current tote task/exchange fields are displayed.
steps.instruction: Open the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen and ensure you are viewing the current tote task information.
steps.expected_result: You can see the Tote Tasks interface fields that describe the current tote task/exchange (including exchange type/priority/original destination/ready-for-exchange and task name/tote ID).
steps.healthy_condition: The Tote Tasks Aveva API page is visible and populated with current task-related tote information.
steps.failure_condition: The Tote Tasks page does not load or does not show the expected current task/exchange fields.

actions.label: Verify Tote Tasks page is visible
actions.exact_action: Open the “Tote Tasks Aveva API” page/screen

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.evidence_quote: “current task and you know, you see what kind of exchange type it's doing, whether it's like the exchange now is like a priority, it's original destination, if it's ready for exchange.”

steps.title: Locate the exchange-related fields and read what exchange type the current task is doing
steps.purpose: Determine the current tote task’s exchange type for diagnosis.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, locate the exchange-related field that indicates what kind of exchange the current task is doing, and read its value.
steps.expected_result: You can state the current tote task’s exchange type as shown on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.
steps.healthy_condition: The exchange type field is visible and has a clear value for the current task.
steps.failure_condition: The exchange type field/value is missing or not displayed on the Tote Tasks page.

actions.label: Read exchange type
actions.exact_action: Locate the exchange-related fields and read what exchange type the current task is doing

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.evidence_quote: “you see what kind of exchange type it's doing”

steps.title: Check whether the exchange is marked as a priority
steps.purpose: Determine whether the current exchange is flagged as priority for diagnosis.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, locate the priority indicator/field for the current exchange and read whether it is marked as a priority.
steps.expected_result: You can state whether the current tote task’s exchange is marked as a priority.
steps.healthy_condition: The priority indicator/field is visible and indicates priority status for the current task.
steps.failure_condition: The priority indicator/field is missing or not displayed for the current task.

actions.label: Read priority status
actions.exact_action: Check whether the exchange is marked as a priority

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.evidence_quote: “whether it's like the exchange now is like a priority”

steps.title: Read the “Original Destination” value and the “Station” value shown for the current task
steps.purpose: Capture where the tote/task is originally destined and which station it is currently associated with.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, read the “Original Destination” value and the “Station” value for the current task.
steps.expected_result: You can state the current tote task’s “Original Destination” and “Station” values as shown on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.
steps.healthy_condition: Both “Original Destination” and “Station” fields are visible and populated for the current task.
steps.failure_condition: Either “Original Destination” or “Station” is missing/not displayed for the current task.

actions.label: Read original destination and station
actions.exact_action: Read the “Original Destination” value and the “Station” value shown for the current task

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.evidence_quote: “it's original destination” and “Original Destination” / “Station” listed in the Tote Tasks interface fields

steps.title: Check whether the tote/task is “ready for exchange”
steps.purpose: Determine whether the current tote/task is ready to proceed with exchange.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, locate the “ready for exchange” indicator/field for the current task and read its status.
steps.expected_result: You can state whether the current tote/task is “ready for exchange” as shown on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.
steps.healthy_condition: The “ready for exchange” field/indicator is visible and indicates a clear ready/not-ready status for the current task.
steps.failure_condition: The “ready for exchange” field/indicator is missing or not displayed for the current task.

actions.label: Read ready-for-exchange status
actions.exact_action: Check whether the tote/task is “ready for exchange.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

steps.title: If shown, note AUV-behind readiness/stations and whether it is associated with the “sorter task UID”
steps.purpose: Capture whether an AUV behind the tote is ready to go and which stations it is at, and whether it is linked to the sorter task UID.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, check the AUV-behind/ready-to-go information. If it indicates an AUV behind is ready to go, note what stations the AUV is at and whether it is associated with the “sorter task UID.”
steps.expected_result: When the page shows AUV-behind readiness, you can state the AUV-behind ready-to-go status, the stations it is at, and the sorter task UID association (if shown).
steps.healthy_condition: AUV-behind readiness/stations and sorter task UID linkage are visible and populated consistently for the current task.
steps.failure_condition: AUV-behind readiness/stations or sorter task UID linkage is missing/not displayed when expected for the current task.

actions.label: Read AUV-behind readiness and sorter task UID
actions.exact_action: If the screen indicates an AUV behind it is ready to go, note what stations the AUV is at and whether it is associated with the “sorter task UID.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.evidence_quote: “it means if there's an AUV behind it ready to go, what stations it's at, if it's on the sorter task UID.”

steps.title: Tap/verify the “Task Name” and record the “Tote Id” shown
steps.purpose: Capture the specific task type (task name) and the tote identifier for reporting and follow-up.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Tasks Aveva API page, tap/verify the “Task Name” (e.g., “pick up tote” if shown) for the current task, and record the “Tote Id” shown.
steps.expected_result: You can state the current task’s “Task Name” and the “Tote Id” shown on the Tote Tasks Aveva API page.
steps.healthy_condition: “Task Name” and “Tote Id” are visible and correspond to the same current task row/entry.
steps.failure_condition: “Task Name” or “Tote Id” is missing/not displayed for the current task.

actions.label: Read task name and tote ID
actions.exact_action: Tap/verify the “Task Name” and record the “Tote Id” shown

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3).

source_evidence.evidence_quote: “tap, you know, task name, it's pick up tote … and of course, the tote ID,” and the OCR listing includes “Task Name” and “Tote Id”.

success_criteria: You can state the current tote task’s exchange type.
You can state whether the exchange is marked as a priority.
You can state the current tote task’s “Original Destination” and “Station”.
You can state whether the tote/task is “ready for exchange”.
When shown, you can state AUV-behind readiness/stations and whether it is associated with the “sorter task UID”.
You can state the “Task Name” and “Tote Id” shown for the current task.
healthy_conditions: Tote Tasks Aveva API page shows current task fields: exchange type, priority, original destination, station, ready-for-exchange, and task name/tote ID.
If AUV-behind readiness is indicated, the page shows the stations it is at and the sorter task UID association.
failure_conditions: Tote Tasks Aveva API page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields.
Required fields (exchange type, priority, original destination, station, ready-for-exchange, task name, tote ID) are missing or not displayed for the current task.
escalation_guidance: If the Tote Tasks page does not show the expected exchange readiness/priority/destination/station fields, stop and escalate to deeper support (L2/L3) since the source does not provide alternate surfaces or troubleshooting steps.
